# Key Files — idle-base

<!-- generated by /kb-generate — last_crawl_commit: bffd7f428878374fc80f9f2b7f802b85c6958dd2 -->

Ordered by how much a contributor needs them, not by size. `package-lock.json` (7205L) is the
largest file in the repo and is irrelevant; `src/data/acts.js` is the one to read first.

## Read these before changing anything

| Path | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| `src/data/acts.js` | **Start here.** 508L. The seven-act structure: each act's `rules` overrides, `modifierBonuses`, `unlocks`, `unlockedBy` and machine-checkable `exit`. Its comments carry the measured tuning runs behind every number and are the closest thing to a design document in the source. Also the home of the `FINAL_ACT_INDEX` (6) vs `PRESTIGE_ACT_INDEX` (5) split — lines 466-491 explain the trap. 15 changes, the most-touched config file. |
| `src/engine/tickEngine.js` | 752L, **21 changes — the most-touched file in the repo.** `advance(state, deltaSeconds)` is the single place simulation happens, live and offline alike. Read `EVENT_CLOCK_CONTRIBUTORS` (line 230) and its contract before adding any timed behaviour: a new wake boundary is an *append*, not an edit to `findNextEventClock()`. |
| `src/state/initialState.js` | The shape of the entire game state, with comments explaining the rule for which slices are `null` (content an act creates) versus present-and-empty (collections `advance()` dereferences every iteration). 15 changes. Read before adding a slice. |
| `src/engine/modifiers.js` | `resolveRules()` (balanceConfig ← act ← era, replace semantics) and `computeModifiers()` (act ← era ← capsShop ← perks ← powerups, additive then clamped). Never read `balanceConfig` directly for anything an act can override. |
| `src/engine/progression.js` | Act transitions. `getUnlockedFeatures(actIndex, expeditionPhase)` — derived, never stored, and now three-layered with `unlockedBy`. `EXIT_PREDICATES` (what ends each act), `ACT_INITIALIZERS` (what each act creates on entry), `CALL_UP_MILESTONE` (Act VI's exit, and the door into Act VII). |
| `src/persistence/saveLoad.js` | 38L, but it sets the hardest constraint in the repo: **no save migration**. A version mismatch discards the save, so every new slice must be readable when absent. |

## Entry points and wiring

| Path | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| `src/index.js` → `src/App.js` → `src/state/GameContext.js` | 8L / 13L / 20L. `createRoot` → `GameProvider` (useReducer over the whole game, hydrated from localStorage) → `AppShell`. |
| `src/components/layout/AppShell.js` | 384L, 16 changes. The router. `PANELS` map keyed by feature id, filtered through `getUnlockedFeatures`; locked tabs are not rendered at all. Early-returns a pre-season shell when `state.season` is absent, so every hook must sit above that return. Carries the Act VII branch (`ResourceChips`, the six expedition tabs, `TeardownOverlay`). Adding a tab means touching this and `TabNav.js`. |
| `src/state/gameReducer.js` | Flat switch delegating to `state/actions/*`. Shared seam — 9 changes; every feature adds a case *and* a require. |
| `src/state/actionTypes.js` | 9 changes. Every action type constant. |
| `src/hooks/useGameTick.js` | 39L. The only timer: 1s TICK, 30s autosave, offline catch-up on mount, save on `visibilitychange`/`beforeunload`. Note the unload save will clobber a hand-injected localStorage fixture during a reload. |

## Act VII — the expedition

| Path | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| `docs/PRD-act-seven-farm-team.md` | 3734L, the largest document in the repo and the spec the whole act implements. Engine comments cite it by section (§5.x modules, §7.x sites and launch, §8.8 puzzles) and by ledger item (R1–R5). Read the relevant section before writing anything in this act. |
| `src/engine/colony.js` | 1000L. Owns `state.expedition`: `expeditionSlice()`, `resolvedSites()`, `colonyRates()`, `integrateColony()`, `nextColonyThresholdClock()`, and `spendResource()` — **Fuel's debit path, because Fuel is not a wallet currency.** Nothing outside this file may reach into `state.expedition` directly. Its `normalizeResource()` header documents the `Number.isFinite`-vs-`||` freeze in full. |
| `src/data/actSevenConfig.js` | The act's **shape**: `EXPEDITION_PHASES` (aftermath → lifeSupport → lunar → deepSpace → majors), `phaseRank()` (the only legal way to compare two phases), the four consumables and their base capacities (**Fuel's is 0, and that is a real value**), solve bounds, and the output/draw modifier key names. Also `LIFE_SUPPORT_PHASE` / `MAJORS_PHASE` (the two phases whose predicate is not a fact about a site, named here so `sites.js` holds no phase-id literals) and `OVER_THE_WALL_MILESTONE` — the act-ending milestone the phase ladder already reads through a defaulted lookup and which returns `false` until STORY-032's win condition sets it. That lookup is the hook the win-condition story lands on. |
| `src/engine/sites.js` | 515L. The colonization ladder, pad tiers, build resolution, `siteReach`, and **the single writer of `expedition.phase`** — recomputed from a pure predicate ladder every iteration. Offer ids are `<buildingId>@<siteId>`. |
| `src/engine/launch.js` | 452L. Commit, transit, arrivals, the overshoot band. **Takes no `rng` at all** — its header is the reference argument for why randomness resolved inside an offline catch-up is unacceptable in this codebase. |
| `src/engine/puzzles.js` | 706L. Artifact puzzles, three-tier hint ladder, instrument shop, attempt governors. **Nothing in `advance()` writes `expedition.puzzles`**, so it is storm-safe by construction. Three routes past every puzzle (solve / hints / operate manually) are the anti-softlock guarantee in structural form. |
| `src/engine/actSevenModules.js` | 175L. The fabrication shop. Availability is a `phaseRank` gate (fails **open**); site-capability requirements fail **closed**. The first Fuel Bladder's `requires` map is a *spend* gate, not a price gate — the pacing control for the entire launch system. |
| `src/engine/colonyReadout.js` | 99L. The header's boundary helper. Presentation reshaping only — one `colonyRates()` call, never a second solve. Read it before adding any number to the Act VII header. |
| `src/data/actSevenPanels.js` | The act's **surface**: six tab ids, labels and placeholder copy. One of three id lists that must agree (with `AppShell`'s `PANELS` and `TabNav`'s `TABS`) and none of the disagreements is caught by the build. |
| `src/data/actSevenPuzzlesConfig.js` | 1032L, the largest `.js` file in the repo. Puzzle content, feedback lines, hint costs. |
| `src/data/actSevenModulesConfig.js` / `actSevenSitesConfig.js` / `actSevenLaunchConfig.js` | 494L / 439L / 220L. The module ladder and costs, the five sites plus pad tiers and capabilities, the transit maths and overshoot band. |
| `src/data/actSevenPalette.js` | The five phase pills, `{ bg, ink }` like `eras.js`. Contrast ratios are computed, not eyeballed; the arithmetic is at the foot of the file. |
| `src/components/expedition/TeardownOverlay.js` | 111L. The franchise teardown at the Act VI→VII boundary. |

## Economy and simulation

| Path | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| `src/engine/income.js` | 159L, 13 changes. Sums every per-second contributor into `{ caps, coins, cash, salvage }`. Where a new passive income source plugs in — as an append to its contributor list. Act VII's `salvagePerSecond()` reads `colonyRates()` rather than re-summing modules, so the ration throttling a starved colony is the same ration the colony integrates against; `salvageOutputMult` is applied here and nowhere else. |
| `src/engine/gameSim.js` | The **one** probability model in the game (`winProbability`, `simulateGame`). Everything that needs odds — games, wall-ball rallies, the bookie's line — routes through it. |
| `src/engine/strength.js` | `STAT_WEIGHTS`, `playerOverall`, `teamStrength`. Walk-up song bonuses apply here at read time. Consumed by the sim, the roster card, the trade panel and camp — so a change here moves everything at once. |
| `src/engine/wallBall.js` | 351L. Act II. Its header documents the recoverability invariant and what it does and does not guarantee — read it before touching stakes, cooldowns or Respect. |
| `src/engine/bookie.js` | 608L. Act IV wagering: moneyline plus the prop board. Note it widened two shared contracts — `settleWager` and `refundOpenWager` also settle/refund props. |
| `src/engine/concessions.js` / `src/data/concessionsConfig.js` | 248L / 330L. Five offer kinds: stands, boosters, caps click upgrades, cash click upgrades, stand multipliers. The most elaborate Acts I–VI shop and the model to copy. |
| `src/engine/clicker.js` | The anti-softlock guarantee. Per-act overridable currency, flat value and cooldown — Act VII pays a flat 8 Salvage every 3s, which is the only ungated income in that act. |
| `src/engine/pacing.js` | Small but easy to get wrong: `gameSpeedMult` is the only modifier that **divides** a duration. All three consumers route through here so the direction is decided once. |
| `src/engine/wallet.js` | Every *currency* write in the game. `creditWallet`/`debitWallet`/`canAfford`/`balanceOf`. Not the path for Act VII's consumables — see `colony.js:spendResource`. |
| `src/engine/prestige.js` | Returns the player to `PRESTIGE_ACT_INDEX` (5). Line 22 documents why reading `FINAL_ACT_INDEX` here would teleport every prestiging player into Act VII. |

## Presentation

| Path | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| `src/styles/global.css` | 3055L, 15 changes, the entire stylesheet. **Ends inside an `@media (max-width: 640px)` block** — appending at EOF silently scopes a rule to mobile. Use the feature-section markers; the Act VII sections sit deliberately above that final block. |
| `src/components/layout/HeaderStats.js` | 264L, 10 changes. Currency chips with live rates and floating gains, the countdown, the folded season/record chip, and the per-era **and per-phase** colour pill through one slot. Space here is contested on a 390px screen. |
| `src/components/layout/ResourceChips.js` | 69L. Renders `colonyReadout.listResources()` rows verbatim — fill fraction, trend sign, seconds-until-empty. Decides no thresholds of its own. |
| `src/components/field/FieldView.js` | The on-field replay, sized to fit inside the gap between games. |
| `src/components/common/ToastHost.js` | Its header documents why toasts are derived from transitions and never stored — an offline catch-up would otherwise fire a storm on load. Read it before adding a toast. |
| `src/data/feedMessages.js`, `toastMessages.js`, `storyBeats.js` (566L), `propBetsConfig.js` | All player-facing prose. A string literal in a component belongs in one of these. |

## Config reference

| Path | Why it matters |
|---|---|
| `src/data/balanceConfig.js` | Base tunables for a fresh run — league size, season length, pacing, costs, offline cap (8h). Every act and era layers over this. |
| `src/data/modifierKeysConfig.js` | `BONUS_KEYS` and their `CLAMPS`. **A modifier key not in this list is silently inert.** Now includes Act VII's `powerOutputMult`, `oxygenOutputMult`, `provisionsOutputMult`, `fuelOutputMult`, `salvageOutputMult` and `lifeSupportDrawMult`. |
| `src/data/eras.js` | Prestige eras: rules overrides, bonuses, and each era's pill colour. Extrapolates past the authored five. |
| `src/data/currencies.js` | The four currencies — caps, coins, cash, **salvage** — and how each displays. Components must not hardcode a currency name. Act VII's four consumables are deliberately *not* here. |
| `src/data/positions.js`, `playerNames.js` | Roster vocabulary. Stat keys are `power`, `contact`, `speed`, **`defense`**, `pitching` — note `defense`, not `fielding`. |
| `docs/PRD-incremental-odyssey.md` | 710L. The PRD Acts I–VI implement; §6.4 is the anti-softlock guarantee the engine comments cite. |
| `openspec/changes/` | 15 recorded changes (`proposal.md`, `design.md`, `tasks.md`, and for 11 of them delta specs at `specs/<capability>/spec.md`) — the architectural decision record for everything above, and where a story's rationale is written down. Committed in this repo. **Read the deltas here, not in `openspec/specs/`** — that directory and `changes/archive/` are empty; nothing has been synced or archived. |
| `package.json`, `webpack.config.js`, `babel.config.js` | Two runtime deps (react, react-dom). Only `start` and `build` scripts — **no test runner**. |
